title: Rethinking "Risk" in Algorithmic Systems Through A Computational Narrative Analysis of Casenotes in Child-Welfare
reasoning: The paper is an empirical sociotechnical study that uses computational narrative analysis and topic modeling to investigate risk assessment in child welfare. While it addresses themes of fairness, bias, and systemic injustice, it does not involve the evaluation or benchmarking of religion, morals, or ethical systems.
